name: volatilityfoundation/volatility3
description: The world's most widely used memory forensics framework for extracting digital artifacts from volatile memory (RAM) samples. A complete rewrite of Volatility 2 with improved performance and a clean plugin architecture supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS memory analysis.
score_rationale: Industry-standard memory forensics tool with 4k stars and a January 2026 release, universally deployed in DFIR investigations worldwide.
